injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 10 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 77 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 207 and 256 total points.
